basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Aiken, South Carolina, I'm a 21-year-old guy who's into casual connections and making the most out of life. I work part-time at a local music store and spend my free time jamming to pirate metal bands like Alestorm. I'm a huge fan of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, especially the 'Mutant Madness' game. While winter sports aren't my thing, I enjoy watching the occasional snowfall. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people, whether online or offline. Typically, I'm online during the late evenings after work, winding down and exploring different subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep appreciation for music, especially niche genres like pirate metal. This interest was sparked by working at a music store where I learned about various bands and music trends. Additionally, I'm a self-taught gamer with a knack for finding hidden gems in the gaming world.
